findings.detail: Gem and dulceață are distinct preparations in the same fruit-preserve neighborhood; miere is bee-produced and remains only the broad fallback.

Self or a strong direct authored edge prevents the multi-hop spillover demonstrated by the rejected global mapping. The 0.60 floor excludes the one current semantically misleading direct edge, Socată at 0.45.
The numeric floor is a reviewed boundary over this exact KG, not a generic semantic rule. Fixture hashing and explicit target enumeration must fail when graph topology changes.
Gem remains a synthetic nonwinning projection. Scoring and target-aware suggestion filtering must use one private effective-anchor helper without exposing either anchor or the hidden target.

limitations: Independent Codex-agent semantic review, not a human linguistic or gameplay study. Approval is bound to the exact proposal, sources and KG. Final landing remains conditional on code, privacy, target enumeration and all-approved-target impact review.
